entries.speaker: Fishing Controls Part 1
entries.en: Using [clr 2][f 1 10 43][clr 27], choose the direction you wish to cast[n]your line, then press [clr 2][f 1 10 22][clr 27] to cast.

entries.speaker: Fishing Controls Part 1
entries.en: The power gauge determines how far you cast.[n]Try pressing [clr 2][f 1 10 22][clr 27] at the right moment to drop[n]your line directly in front of a fish.

entries.speaker: Fishing Controls Part 1
entries.en: Once you've cast your line, wait for the fish to[n]take the bait. You can choose different bait and[n]recast the line by pressing [clr 2][f 1 10 70][clr 27].

entries.speaker: Fishing Controls Part 1
